entry.title: Cosmic-Ide/Cosmic-IDE
entry.summary: IDE for JVM development. Uses Shizuku for an embedded shell

entry.title: knoop7/Ava-Pro
entry.summary: Ava turns any Android 5+ device into a voice-first Home Assistant kiosk. Native C++ under the hood, so a 10-year-old tablet still listens, talks, and runs the house - with AirPlay-grade audio in every room, all in sync.

entry.title: wuyhong715/rikkahub-agent-pure
entry.summary: RikkaHub Agent · Pure — an Android AI agent that survives long runs. Independent hardening pass on the rikkahub on-device agent: usage ledger & budgets, on-demand tools, expert sub-agents, cold memory, chained workflows. Kotlin/Compose, Shizuku/Termux/MCP. QQ group 1030362371.

entry.title: langraficagr-collab/adaptive-performance
entry.summary: Adaptive Performance: otimização inteligente de bateria, temperatura, RAM e apps em segundo plano no Android com modo automático, meta de bateria e Shizuku.

entry.title: MT Manager
entry.summary: Split-screen file manager. Can install APKs and access Android/data and Android/obb using Shizuku
